BUILD INFERENCE THAT RUNS WHERE THE DATA LIVES

We're a small team building SIE, an open-source inference engine that serves embeddings, reranking and extraction through one API. It runs 85+ models in your own cloud, not behind a metered API.

🤖 What we do

Every AI app that searches or makes sense of documents has the same thing humming away underneath it: models. Something to turn text into embeddings, something to rerank the results, something to pull the entities out.

Now think about how you actually get those models running today. You either rent them from a managed API, paying by the token and shipping your data off to someone else's cloud, or you stitch together a pile of separate model servers and spend your week babysitting them.

Now imagine one API instead. Three calls, encode, score, extract, backed by 85+ open-source models. It starts as a container on your laptop, and the exact same code scales to a production cluster running in your own cloud.

At Superlinked, we're building SIE, the open-source inference engine that makes that real, so AI Engineers can experiment locally, ship to production, and keep their data where it belongs. All Apache 2.0.

✨ What we offer

  • 🎁 Compensation

    Enjoy a competitive salary and meaningful equity  so you’re not just part of Superlinked’s journey, you own a piece of its success.

  • 🏝️ Hybrid Work

    We’re remote-first, but we still love real-world coffee chats and in-person collaboration, with hubs in San Francisco, London, Budapest and Tel Aviv.

  • 💥 Retreats

    Twice a year, we reserve a co-living space in an inspiring location, like Mallorca, Montenegro, Balaton, or Istanbul, and spend a week together, blending focused work with a bit of adventure.

  • 🥁 Motivation

    Superlinked offers unique opportunities to learn across multiple roles, gain high-visibility career growth, and make a meaningful impact by shaping products, processes, and company culture.


  • 🐤 Parental leave

    We support families,including fathers as well, so they can spend one of the most important moments of their lives with their families.

  • 💻 Devices

    We strive to make everyday work as easy and efficient as possible for our employees, providing everyone with new, high-quality devices to support their work.

Our culture values

  • Own It

    We take full ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. We hold ourselves accountable, act with reliability, and remove our own obstacles to move things forward.

  • Keep Growing

    We embrace a growth mindset, learning fast, adapting boldly, and seeing every challenge as a chance to improve. We move with urgency, stay curious, and strive to be better every day.

  • Challenge, Then Commit

    We speak up openly, challenge ideas with data, and make decisions based on evidence. Once we decide, we align fully, act decisively, and focus our energy where it creates the most value.

  • Respect & Collaboration

    We treat everyone with fairness and dignity, solving problems together instead of assigning blame. We communicate clearly, write things down, and build trust through transparency and respect.
